description: This file defines a catalog of books for a bookstore frontend, including functions for price generation, book normalization, and category filtering. It exports book lists for trending, global bestsellers, and Indian bestsellers, along with genre configurations and utility functions.

methods.name: priceFromSeed
methods.description: Generates a deterministic price from a string seed, selecting from allowed prices.

methods.name: normalizeBook
methods.description: Normalizes a book object to ensure required fields and valid price.
